name: Vegas Aviation
summary: Las Vegas flight school with a fleet of eight Cessna 172s and an itemized private pilot estimate.
differentiator: States the hours behind its estimate: its $17,285 private pilot total assumes 62 flight hours and 2 simulator hours, and the dual hour works out to $235 ($175 aircraft plus $60 instruction).
pricing: Cessna 172 from $175 an hour, instruction from $60 an hour, Duchess from $425.

instruction.label: Flight instruction, starting at
instruction.note: Billed in addition to the aircraft rate.

estimate.hoursBasis: 62 flight hours and 2 simulator hours: 50 hours dual at $235 an hour, 10 hours solo at $175, 20 hours of ground instruction at $60
estimate.note: Includes a $765 onboarding kit with the Cessna online course, a 2-hour checkride aircraft rental ($350) and the $1,200 examiner fee.

bestFor: Students who want a full private pilot estimate with the checkride included.
skipIf: You want a firm hourly rate rather than "starting at" prices.
watchOut: Rates are "starting at" prices, so a given aircraft may cost more.
The page does not say whether the aircraft rate includes fuel.
